note: The effective provider configuration of the proposed (unapproved) Nemotron run, computed offline from revision 8's package with a placeholder key and blocked sockets, no environment override; nothing was sent. `profile` is what the harness registers and compares (scripts/run_evaluation.py, provider_profile); `describe` is the provider's full self-description.

describe.response_format: json_schema wrapper {name, schema, strict} (raw schema is rejected with 422 despite the docs)
describe.transport_retry_policy: a request that was never sent (its connection, proxy tunnel or TLS handshake failed before any byte of it was written) closes its reservation at a known $0 and is sent again at most 2 times after 2/6 s, each attempt under a new reservation, each recorded and counted against the call cap; a request whose bytes were written is never sent again (its reservation stays committed)
describe.reservation_policy: the USD reservation is journaled durably (fsync) and read back before dispatch, after any cut journal tail has been terminated with a journal_repair record; if it cannot be, the request is not sent and the run stops paid calls
describe.metering_policy: an HTTP 200 whose usage cannot price the generation (missing, empty, partial or malformed counters) keeps its reservation unsettled and stops further paid calls of the run pending reconciliation; explicit zero counters settle as 0
describe.call_cap_policy: at most 22 model calls per run (failed calls and retries count); the call that would exceed it is refused before dispatch
